pages.title: Three-card tarot online for a practical read
pages.intro: A clean three-card flow: identify the situation, notice the useful signal, and choose a doable action.
pages.questionLabel: What should this quick reading help you navigate?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: How can I prepare for an important meeting?
pages.journalPrompt: Save one sentence you want to remember when you close this reading.
pages.resultCopy: Use the result like a good app prompt: short enough to act on, specific enough to test.
pages.metaDescription: Use a free three-card tarot reading online to turn a question into one practical next action.

pages.title: Love tarot app reading for the connection
pages.intro: Check the emotional signal, the shared need, and the next conversation that could make a difference.
pages.questionLabel: What relationship question are you carrying on your phone today?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: What would make our next conversation more honest?
pages.journalPrompt: Turn one insight into a message that is direct, kind, and easy to answer.
pages.resultCopy: A useful reading should make communication clearer, not replace it.
pages.metaDescription: Try a free mobile love tarot reading about emotional signals, shared needs, and communication.

pages.title: Yes or no tarot app reflection
pages.intro: Ask one decision question, draw once, and review the real-world context before you choose.
pages.questionLabel: Which choice are you comparing right now?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: Should I accept this invitation this weekend?
pages.journalPrompt: Check your calendar, energy, and constraints before treating the signal as useful.
pages.resultCopy: The card is a prompt, not an answer key. Your context supplies the final decision.
pages.metaDescription: Get a free yes-or-no tarot app-style reflection with a grounded decision prompt.

pages.title: Open a daily tarot card
pages.intro: A lightweight daily draw for one theme, one question, and one action you can carry offline.
pages.questionLabel: What deserves your attention before the day fills up?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Optional: add a word for today’s focus.
pages.journalPrompt: Choose one action small enough to complete before bedtime.
pages.resultCopy: Keep the insight close, then let your own observations update it as the day unfolds.
pages.metaDescription: Open a free daily tarot card and turn its theme into one practical action.
